candidates.name: sci-Plex family (sciPlex1/2/4), Srivatsan et al. Science 2020

access.license: GEO terms for raw; scPerturb derivative CC BY 4.0
access.estimated_size: sciPlex3-class experiments ~1-12 GB per experiment (matrix + metadata)

design.sciPlex1_GSM4150376: untreated human/mouse species-mixing barnyard; not a perturbation-response source
design.sciPlex2_GSM4150377: four compounds (BMS345541, dexamethasone, nutlin-3A, SAHA) x 8 dose tokens incl. zero + vehicle; official hash sample sheet: 192 rows, 32 agent-dose groups x 6 rows; six hash rows are NOT verified biological replicates
design.sciPlex3_GSM4150378: the 188-compound x 4-dose large screen; LOCAL (raw/sciplex3); no duplicate download
design.sciPlex4_GSM4150379: chemical/metabolic rescue: abexinostat/pracinostat x acetyl-CoA precursors (Acetate, Citrate, Pyruvate) or enzyme inhibitors (ACLY, ACSS2, PDH) + DMSO/Chloride tokens; A549/MCF7; 624-row sample sheet; 206 raw token combinations before collapsing equivalent zero-dose conditions; NOT a genetic rescue; no sequential decision history

units.independent_perturbation_units: sciPlex2: 4 compounds; sciPlex3: 188 compounds (local); sciPlex4: ~8 distinct small-molecule/metabolite identities in combination, NOT 206 independent compounds; dose tokens and cell lines are conditions
units.verified_counts: sciPlex2 sample-sheet counts verified by REVIEW (192 rows, 32 groups); sciPlex4 sample-sheet counts verified by REVIEW (624 rows, 206 raw combinations); replicate structure unverified

outcome_quality.outcome_type: raw UMI counts (direct measurement); vehicle controls present
outcome_quality.qc_failure_data: per-cell QC feasible from raw counts; no explicit attempted-experiment failure table
outcome_quality.negatives_ambiguous: retained in raw counts (undetected responses are measurable)

overlap.detail: sciPlex3 is local development data; sciPlex2/4 are sibling experiments with small distinct compound sets. Usable for development/calibration pilots; NOT untouched evaluation sources.

suitability.fit: small contract pilots: dose response (sciPlex2), chemical/metabolic rescue cases (sciPlex4)
suitability.confidence: high on metadata; replicate structure pending

candidates.name: Genome-wide Perturb-seq (K562 genome-scale, K562 essential, RPE1 essential), Replogle et al. Cell 2022

access.portal: https://gwps.wi.mit.edu/ (SRA for FASTQ/BAM, figshare for MEX and processed)
access.formats: AnnData h5ad: raw single-cell, raw pseudobulk, gemgroup Z-normalized single-cell and pseudobulk
access.estimated_size: pseudobulk files hundreds of MB; single-cell files tens of GB (screen first)

design.system: K562 (CRISPRi, all expressed genes, day 8; essentials, day 6), RPE1 (essentials, day 7)
design.perturbation: CRISPRi sgRNA; 9,866 targeted genes (K562 gwps); median 166 cells per perturbation (author-reported)

units.independent_perturbation_units: target genes are a grouping/split key, NOT a biological replicate count; shared guides, plates, controls and pathways induce dependencies; gemgroup lanes are not automatically biological replicates
units.verified_counts: 9,866 K562 gwps targets (author figure, consistent across two independent reuses); cell counts author-reported

outcome_quality.outcome_type: raw counts + author z-normalized pseudobulk (derived; rebuild own effects from raw counts)
outcome_quality.qc_failure_data: guide efficiency must be retained; not a failure-denominator dataset

overlap.detail: chemical identity overlap is not applicable to a genetic dataset. Foundation-model (State) training exposure is NOT established: source-code examples mentioning Replogle do not prove use by the active checkpoint; a checkpoint-specific training/validation manifest is required before any clean-evaluation claim.

suitability.fit: a separately specified genetic perturbation benchmark and an orthogonal genetic evidence layer
suitability.not_eligible_for: direct calibration of small-molecule mechanism-conditional outcome probabilities (no domain bridge defined)
suitability.confidence: high on access and license; genetic-task design not yet specified

candidates.name: Tahoe-100M single-cell perturbation atlas (Zhang et al., Cell 2026 / bioRxiv 2025)

access.download: 337.6 GB parquet (full), streaming supported (verified 2026-09-29); Arc Virtual Cell Atlas on GCS (Requester Pays) since 2026-03
access.license_note: one older HF README revision says MIT; current card and the Cell paper state CC0-1.0 - use CC0-1.0, flag the discrepancy

design.system: 50 cancer cell lines (cell-village pools), 379 small molecules (drug_metadata verified 2026-09-29: 379 rows, 374 unique InChIKey blocks)
design.perturbation: compounds at limited doses, SINGLE time point (publication limitation)
design.replication: replicate plates; pseudobulk highly concordant, derived single-cell phenotypes only moderately reproducible (publication)

units.independent_perturbation_units: 374 blocks x 50 lines is a possible condition grid, NOT 18,700 independent compounds; coverage not yet counted; 189 blocks absent from two GSE sources are not automatically absent from PRISM, sciPlex3, other local sources or pretraining; 2 unparsed drugs (Sacubitril/Valsartan, Verteporfin) remain unknown

outcome_quality.outcome_type: raw single-cell counts (direct); transcriptomically inferred phenotypes are derived (publication warning)
outcome_quality.qc_failure_data: cell-level filters documented; no attempted-experiment failure denominator

overlap.detail: State checkpoint (local arc_state) trained on Tahoe (public documentation + local tahoe_var.json). Excluded for evaluation of the Tahoe-trained checkpoint; overlap-declared diagnostics and evaluation of a separately trained nonoverlapping model are different claims. Any component consuming State embeddings/predictions inherits the exposure; a per-component dependency/exposure ledger is required.

suitability.fit: independent calibration at scale (Role B), state-conditioned response (Role A) for non-VC components
suitability.confidence: high on access and metadata; medium on annotation coverage

candidates.name: MIX-Seq (McFarland, Paolella et al., Nat Commun 2020)

access.contents: single-cell UMI count matrices + drug sensitivity + genomic features of the cell lines

design.system: pools of ~100 cancer cell lines, SNP-demultiplexed; cell hashing for extra conditions (time points, doses)
design.perturbation: small molecules (main experiments around a dozen compounds incl. trametinib, dabrafenib, navitoclax, BRD3379) and genetic perturbations
design.outcome_link: long-term viability predictable from short-term transcriptional response (publication claim) - a measured response-to-phenotype bridge

units.independent_perturbation_units: cell line x compound pairs; ~100 lines x ~10-24 compounds (author scale; exact count NOT verified from metadata)

overlap.detail: its compounds are known oncology agents present in GSE phases/PRISM; the measurement modality (single-cell) is new to the project. Declare compound overlap; usable for development and bridge evaluation, not as untouched chemistry.

suitability.fit: response-to-viability bridge and multi-context response; Role D molecular-to-phenotype link

outcome_quality.drug_sensitivity: sens = 1 - AUC_avg, averaged from quantile-normalized PRISM and GDSC values where available (source README): EXTERNAL LINKAGE, not same-experiment viability follow-up; audit compound/cell/dose/assay-time alignment and normalization scope before scoring
